states.locked: Reward item has not been received. Show the icon gray.
states.unlocked: Reward item has been received. Show the icon in color. Gear, the stat, or the resource bundle is yours.
states.finished: This slot's location has been checked. Show a checkmark. For a research, that means it was crafted and sent.

modes.icons: Uses locked, unlocked, and finished. No placement data.
modes.source: Uses research_access to choose the rule text: parents, tier doors, materials, or crafted parents. sequential_tiers says the door items are in the previous tier of this world.
modes.cheatSheet: Needs a scout or a hint for each location. The static catalog does not know that a blueberry check holds a bow.

seedFlags.drop_checks: Slot data on seeds generated after 0.2.5. Older seeds: on when any Gather location exists.
seedFlags.boss_checks: Slot data boss_drops. On by default for seeds generated after 0.2.29. Off when only the goal boss location exists.
seedFlags.research_access: Slot data int. 0 default, 1 tier, 2 materials, 3 natural. Missing on the current seed. Not inferable.
seedFlags.sequential_tiers: Slot data 0 or 1. Missing on the current seed. Not inferable.
